How the scoring works

No peeking at tomorrow

You decide at each day's close and earn the next day's move. Each trade costs 0.05%. Cash earns that day's 3-month Treasury bill rate, and S&P 500 positions earn dividends.

V(t+1) = V(t) · (1 + e·r_mkt + (1−e)·r_cash)

The quant you race

It follows two rules trend-following funds use: stay invested only above the 200-day average, and size the bet to target 15% volatility.

size = 1[P > SMA200] · min(1, 15% / σ20)

Skill or luck?

2,000 random traders make as many trades as you, on random days. Beat 95% of them and your timing is better than chance (a permutation test).

p ≈ share of random traders above you
